sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000175-P1, was presented by PFIZER (the Supplier) to Redwood Care Partners 175 on May 12, 2025.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: an administrative fee of 2.5%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a commitment of 220 Pneumococcal doses per year.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: awaiting a Customer decision.
